title: LexiconChunk
description: Generated by tools/ingest.py from OpenRussian + FrequencyWords. Never edit by hand; use tools/overrides.json.

en.description: English senses; each sense may hold comma-separated synonyms.

rank.description: Lemma frequency rank (OpenSubtitles, lemmatised with pymorphy3). Homographs share a rank.

level.description: Derived from rank bands (see PROGRESS.md); absent when unranked.

sub.description: pymorphy3/OpenCorpora POS tags for 'other' words (PREP, CONJ, ADVB, NPRO, PRCL, ...).

forms.description: Positional cells in the slot order of src/data/lexicon/slots.json for this pos. A cell holds variants joined by '|'. Leading '*' = rare/archaic variant; leading '?' = unverified (pymorphy3 disagrees or stress missing). Generators use only unmarked variants. Empty string = no such form.
